graphic.alt: An adult washes a coarse sack in a shallow basin.
graphic.caption: Washing the sack: an image of a lesson that stays.
graphic.creator: Project Odisha

title: A lesson that stays with you
literal_meaning: You will keep washing the sack and singing praises.
explanation: The praise has an ironic edge. The source explains the expression as remembering someone after receiving a hard lesson from them. The repeated work of washing the sack makes that memory linger: the consequences remain after the encounter is over. It can be a rueful comment on having been taken in, rather than sincere gratitude.
meaning_odia: ଅଖା ଧୋଇବା ସହିତ ଗୁଣ ଗାଇବାର କଥା ଶୁଣିଲେ ପ୍ରଶଂସା ପରି ଲାଗେ। କିନ୍ତୁ ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ ଏହା ଅନ୍ୟଠାରୁ ପାନେ ପାଇ ତାକୁ ମନେ ପକାଇବା। ଘଟଣାଟି ସରିଗଲେ ବି ତାହାର ଫଳ ଭୋଗିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ୁଛି। ସେହି ଅନୁଭବକୁ ନେଇ ଏଠାରେ ଟିକେ କଟାକ୍ଷ ଅଛି; ଏହା ସରଳ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A buyer keeps repairing a supposedly excellent second-hand bicycle and ruefully remembers the seller’s promises. (Original imagined occasion, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source supplies the hard-lesson gloss but no story explaining why a sack is washed. The sack image and ironic praise are retained without inventing that missing story.
odia_summary: ପାନେ ପାଇବା ପରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଘଟଣାର ଫଳ ଭୋଗିବା ଓ ତାହାକୁ କଟାକ୍ଷରେ ମନେ ପକାଇବା।
english_summary: The trouble continues, and so does the rueful memory of who brought it about.
